senses.gloss: pl. טְפִיחִים, טְפִיחִין stinted, poor grains; [another opinion: (v. טָפַח I, a. cmp. סָפִיחַ) growth between grass].
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 9:4">Shebi. IX, 4</cite>. Y. ib. 39ᵃ top <he>טפחין</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 7:15">Tosef. ib. VII, 15</cite> <cite ref="T00503"><he>רחיפין</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>רפיחין</he>, <he>ספיחין</he>). [<cite ref="Tosefta Tevul Yom 1:1">Tosef. T’bul Yom. I, 1</cite>, sq., v. <cite ref="I00200"><he>טוֹפַח</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: (sub. רעב) one looking like those who suffer from the effects of famine, yellowish-black.
units: Bekh. 45ᵇ שחור … יצא מהן טָפוּחַ ed. (Rashi טפיח) a very dark-complected man must not marry an equally complected woman, lest their offspring may be a t’fiaḥ; [Rashi: black as a pitcher, v. טְפִיחַ I].
